# Mind Elixir vendored reader assets

These files were ported from `YuriyLin/PaperRead` at
`22ccc94e9085a6a759b184ade7486c9d9e96ccf6`; they were first introduced there
by commit `60a645f91fe8307188d9410d8d84ade3e5a9b4e3`.

The upstream project is [SSShooter/mind-elixir-core](https://github.com/SSShooter/mind-elixir-core)
(npm package `mind-elixir`), distributed under the MIT license. `LICENSE` is
copied verbatim from the upstream license at commit
`bdc450ca2b072675817b26a9857143e09e85a5d0`:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ssshooter/mind-elixir-core/bdc450ca2b072675817b26a9857143e09e85a5d0/LICENSE

The PaperRead binary identifies itself as `mind-elixir-fork`; its exact upstream
release/build recipe was not recorded in the source repository. Do not treat
this binary as a verified build of a numbered npm release. A reproducible
upstream rebuild would require a separate compatibility review.

EasyRead adds the upstream license notice to the CSS and IIFE so it remains in
single-file offline exports. No runtime changes were made to these two assets.
Original PaperRead SHA-256 values, before those notices:

- `MindElixir.css`: `56bf9a67508c618c0b56883f638f350c2fc1b931fa5a071902b7e20679393ae0`
- `MindElixir.iife.js`: `69063ca0d913eb71b6793291ff55b2f2b2efcb019b5e26148f1b4f7dd45004a2`
